question.text: Which of the following statements regarding the 'Best Practices for Portfolio Managers' is CORRECT?

answer.text: Are voluntary but widely adopted APMI-issued standards

explanation.text: The Logic: APMI Best Practices are voluntary codes of conduct, widely adopted by reputable PMs. They complement SEBI regulations. The Trap: They don't supersede regs; nor are they binding — just expected by institutional clients. Cross-Exam Context: NEW for XXI-B (not in XXI-A Distributor Code). Manager's Pro-Tip: Publish Best Practices adherence status on the company website — signals institutional maturity to clients.
